items: 20 miniature Reese's peanut butter cups, unwrapped and chopped
Melt Kisses in microwave until chocolate is melted when stirred.
Stir in 3 1/2 cups whipped topping until blended.
Spread half of the chocolate mixture into crust.
Sprinkle with cut-up Reese's, saving some for garnish.
Top with remaining chocolate mixture. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set.
Spread with remaining whipped topping just before serving and garnish with remaining Reese's.
